claimBoundary: Every plotted curve is an analytic theorem or committed certificate envelope, not a simulated trajectory. The selected-root estimates assume the R0.71Y unit-modulus carrier phases, real shear, fixed target, and full data/root-time enstrophy floors. They do not construct growing exact roots or count every nonlinear root. The equal-grid inverse lower bound is a conditioning warning, not an upper bound on the true nonlinear IFT radius. The figure is not DNS and proves no universal endpoint estimate or Navier--Stokes regularity statement.

evidenceMap.A: exact lattice identity and analytic upper bound
evidenceMap.B: exact nonlinear selected-root theorem envelopes, normalized only for N-law comparison
evidenceMap.C: exact determinant-based equal-grid inverse lower bound
